spans.s: This maxim is based on an event. Once a big tree was floating on the current of a river. A bear was also being carried along with it. Thinking that it is some blanket, two persons jumped in the current of water to catch it. But, alas, the bear pounced on them and killed both of them. The maxim avers that any rash action ultimately leads to ruin.
This maxim describes the firm grip of any person by giving an example of a bear whose hold is so firm that it becomes very difficult for any person to get release out of it.
